description: Make a PDF report and get a link to it, good for a day: give project_id for the project's data report (what data covers the area, what is missing, the team's files and scenarios) or scenario_id for a scenario report (its habitats against their targets, its kept Marxan runs compared, the best run habitat by habitat). The PDF is built when the link is opened, for the person who asked. Read-only.
name: make_report
title: Make a PDF report
